purpose: Render one persisted or inspectable notification item without owning transport or storage.
useWhen: a product has a persisted event or task message with read state
avoidWhen: transient action feedback or page-local validation
accessibility: Exposes read state in the accessible name and retains semantic list-item structure.
Actions for viewing, marking read, and dismissing are independently keyboard reachable.
responsive: Allows long notification content to wrap without horizontal clipping.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: notification
api.description: Consumer-owned notification data and read state.

api.name: onMarkRead
api.description: Marks the item read in consumer state.

api.name: onDismiss
api.description: Removes or archives the item in consumer state.

api.name: onSelect
api.description: Opens the item detail in consumer state.

useWhen: a product needs semantic status, recovery, progress, or event feedback
avoidWhen: the message would become business truth, routing, or a data source
navigationOverlayFeedback.intent: Present one persisted or inspectable event item with read state and optional action.
compatibility: Consumes the existing @ten4seven/ui export and catalog entry.
Consumers retain ownership of route, business, persistence, and event truth.
Web CSS and Native descriptors are projections of this semantic contract, not separate authorities.
